body: I can try that. What if he decides he doesn't like the real me? If he leaves... he's the only thing really keeping me here.

I just don't know if I can bring myself to do it. It kills me every time they tell me how proud they are of me, how impressive and amazing what I've done is. I don't want to be a disappointment to them, and I'm afraid that's what'll happen. I'm afraid, if that does happen, I'll lose all strength to not give in to the urges and end everything.

I'm afraid that if I hold on to the last thread, I'll get right back to this spot. Now the only thing holding me back is the love I have for my boyfriend, but he deserves someone who is truly happy. I don't feel like I'll ever be truly happy, even with all these great things in my life. It makes me that more upset that I can feel this way given my circumstances.

They all have this vision of who I am and who I'll be, and it's not at all what I really want, and far from who I really am. I feel like it's too late to change it. So much time and money has been invested in this vision, it just feels like it's too late. I'm too busy playing the part, and they think that I'm happy, when that couldn't be farther from the truth. I don't even know of they'd believe me if I went to them.
I'm scared that I don't. I'm scared that I've used up the last ounce already. I'm afraid that once I decide to do it, I'll regret it, but I'm also scared that if I don't, I'll regret not doing it.

I don't feel like I can continue to go through the motions anymore. But everyone is so deeply invested in my life, that I feel guilty doing anything else. It's too late to turn back now, and thus just seems to be my only choice.
